subject: Temporary throughput uplift — clarification on rate ladder & overrun reconciliation
messages:
From: Samira Holt <samira@versalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Versalytics Procurement <procure@versalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Launch week capacity ask — short window uplift + invoice handling

Hi Irene,

Quick one from our launch engineering team: over the next three days we expect a concentrated burst of inference traffic for our new feature rollout (estimated 48–72 hour window). Our current quota will likely trigger overrun billing mid-week.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood provision a temporary throughput uplift (soft cap increase) for the 72-hour window to avoid throttling?
2) If we do hit overrun, can your team apply a pro-rated invoice smoothing or a one-time credit given this is our first production week? We have a signed contract (PO in process) but want to avoid service disruption and noisy ticketing in the middle of launch.

Attached is a simplified forecast (versalytics-MAR-launch-forecast.xlsx). Happy to jump on a short call to walk through volume patterns.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Holt
Head of Platform Engineering, Versalytics
samira@versalytics.com
+1 415-555-0192


From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samira Holt <samira@versalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity ask — short window uplift + invoice handling

Samira — thanks for the heads-up and the forecast. We can help here. Quick responses inline and proposed next steps: 

1) Temporary uplift: We can open a soft-cap increase for a 72-hour window. That will raise your rate limit and quota for the nominated project and avoid throttling. To do this we need confirmation of the exact time window (start/end UTC) plus which API key(s) to target. There is no change to the per-token rate while the window is active.

2) Billing / credit: Since you’re a new production customer and this is a short, launch-related burst, we can offer a one-time 50% credit on any overrun charges incurred during the uplift window, applied as a post-invoice credit (applies only to overrun line items, not committed usage). We’ll need PO confirmation or payment terms to finalize. If you want this formalized I’ll ask Legal/Finance to draft an amendment (short form).

Next steps:
- If you confirm start/end times and API keys before EOD today, we’ll schedule the uplift to start within 4 business hours of your window.
- I’ll loop in Ben and Laura for the billing amendment & invoice handling.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com


From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samira Holt <samira@versalytics.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity ask — short window uplift + invoice handling

Samira, Irene — adding the billing detail so expectations are clear.

Laura and I reviewed the forecast. Two clarifications on our side before we finalise the 50% overrun credit path:
- The credit will cover token overrun charges billed at the standard pay-as-you-go overrun rate. It does not apply to any pre-committed reserved capacity line items or to third-party infra surcharges.
- We will apply the credit as an invoice adjustment on the month-end invoice that contains the overrun line items. If you prefer a standalone credit memo earlier we can expedite but that requires procurement sign-off.

If you confirm the PO number or provide the payment terms, Laura will prepare the short amendment (PDF) and route for signature. I’ve attached a draft we usually use for short-term uplifts (proposed-amendment-v2.pdf).

Ben Carter
Senior Revenue Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com


From: Samira Holt <samira@versalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Versalytics Procurement <procure@versalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 17:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity ask — short window uplift + invoice handling

Thanks — this works. Confirming the uplift window: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z through 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z (72 hours). API key prefix: vers-prod-*.

PO number: VLY-67934 (procurement copied here for invoice flow). We would prefer the credit applied as an adjustment on the next invoice rather than a separate credit memo — that’s fine.

Please proceed with the soft-cap increase and share the amendment PDF for signature. One small ask: can we cap our monthly liability for the month to 1.5x our committed monthly spend for this launch window (just to limit exposure)? If that requires a different approval path let us know — procurement is standing by.
